Third-party code vendored for FEATURE 16 (resume files: _shared/career_resume_ingest_files.ts). Each file is the
package's published build, byte for byte; nothing is edited. Re-vendor only by replacing the file whole and updating
the pins below (and the sha256 pins in tests/architect/resume-files-vendor.test.ts).
